summary: Clarifies how the SIP REFER method is affected by the revised event framework in RFC 6665. It points out the consequences of the changed requirements and updates the REFER definition in RFC 3515 to remove ambiguity.

eli5.summary: When the rulebook for one game changes, a neighboring game's rules need a note too. This is that note for call transfers.

questions: how does sip refer work with rfc 6665
what changed for refer in the sip events framework
